name: ANSI/IEEE variable resistor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for variable resistor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The variable-resistor form combines a resistive path with an adjustment indication. The adjustable range and connected terminals determine whether the circuit uses it as a resistance or part of a divider; the arrow is not automatically a separate supply lead.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Distinguish a parameter adjustment from an electrical terminal.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A variable resistor's adjustment and a directional signal arrow carry different meanings.
